scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=jjb-wms-app
scripts.d1:seed-local: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.d1:seed-remote: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.d1:reseed-local: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs --reseed && wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.d1:reseed-remote: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs --reseed && wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.d1:verify: wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM materials) AS materials, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_lots) AS lots, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes) AS recipes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_ingredients) AS ingredients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_material_balance_reconciliation WHERE variance_sec != 0) AS unbalanced_items"
